summary: Papra is a self-hosted document storage, management and archiving platform designed with a minimalist interface. It provides a centralised system to organise and store digital files for easier retrieval. The project is open-source under the AGPL-3.0 licence and maintains high developer activity.
goodFor: It is a suitable option if you want a straightforward, lightweight digital filing system without the complexity of enterprise content management software.
watchOut: Because the platform focuses heavily on minimalism, it may lack advanced document processing features, collaborative editing, or granular access controls found in more established alternatives.
deployNotes: Deployment relies on Docker, so you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for file storage and set up a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
